description: This file contains unit tests for the CountersGrain class, testing event sourcing functionalities such as concurrent increments, state management, and resets within an Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: CountersGrainTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CountersGrain's event sourcing functionalities, including concurrent updates and state resets.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Tests adding multiple increments to a counter, verifying tentative state, and resetting counters.

methods.name: ConcurrentIncrements
methods.description: Runs a test to perform multiple concurrent increments on the grain.

methods.name: ConcurrentIncrementsRunner
methods.description: Performs a specified number of concurrent increments on the grain, verifies tentative and confirmed states, and resets counters.
